contractEnforcements.gateScript: scripts/check-release-gate.js — dependency-free; conditions 1,2,4,5,6,7,8,12 DELEGATE to the existing single-purpose validators (child process, judged on exit code + artifact JSON); condition 3 judged from the test manifest (every tests/e2e/ file passed, floor >= 15 files); condition 9 is a declaration-level Electron packaging-readiness check (devDeps exactly {electron, electron-builder}, zero runtime deps, build block shape, files allowlist exactly [main.js, preload.js, renderer/**/*], every config-referenced asset exists, renderer tree free of .DS_Store/.map/node_modules, every index.html script src exists on disk); conditions 10/11 verify the release-notes draft sections and the CHANGELOG hooks. ALL 12 conditions always run (no short-circuit); exit 0 only when 12/12 PASS; exit 1 on any failure; exit 2 on gate crash.
contractEnforcements.whyCondition9IsDeclarationLevel: scripts/check-version-policy.js forbids npm install / electron-builder / build:* text in .github/workflows/*.yml — CI is install-free by governance design, so an actual electron-builder run cannot execute in CI. The actual build is a LOCAL F5 evidence step recorded in localBuildEvidence below; the gate's condition 9 enforces everything about build readiness that is verifiable without installing.
